arm_b_zero_regression.reading: The repair adds only REJECTIONS -- it never alters the Newton iteration, so on any row both modules accept, the returned c must be bit-comparable.  max_c_delta_on_accepted is that check.

arm_c_margins_and_head_to_head.threshold_provenance: leg 202's own pre-committed classifier threshold, adopted UNCHANGED, not retuned here
arm_c_margins_and_head_to_head.reading: D1 is the diagnostic this leg was DISPATCHED to incorporate. It is measured here as a rejector on the same rows and it fails: its smallest off-branch value is BELOW its largest on-branch value, so no threshold on D1 separates the two classes at all. D2 is exactly 0.0 on the M1 off-branch roots -- it is retained because it is what catches M2/M3, not M1. D3 is the only one of the three that separates.

arm_c2_does_D3_discriminate.reading: For D3 to report the other answer on the off-branch cases, the returned profile's far-field supremum would have to fall below 100x the anchor's 6.48e-06 on the same grid -- i.e. the grid-scale oscillation leg 202 measured at node-to-node 0.80 would have to not exist. The far-field tail ladder brackets the crossing between a 1e-4 tail (passes) and a 1e-3 one (fails), and the measured inflation matches the predicted tail / 6.48e-06 to the recorded relative error -- so the test responds quantitatively to the far field it claims to measure, rather than firing on everything.

arm_d_route_d_v11_rederivation.method: v11 v3/v4 use ONLY cold solve(); solve()'s iteration is character-identical pre/post repair, so each row is computed once and BOTH verdict tests are applied to it. Verified, not assumed: see bit_identical_check. v2 uses continuation, which DID change, so v2 is run against both modules.

last_machine_precision_a.marginality_caveat: a = 0.64 sits at D3 = 113.9, only 1.14x above the 100x threshold. The corrected value is 0.52 if that row is off-branch and 0.64 if it is not. a = 0.70 (D3 = 214.6) and a = 0.72 (D3 = 677.8, the banked value itself) are not marginal on any reading.

grid_converged_a_max.monotonicity_note: The repaired verdict is strictly more restrictive than v11's own test (relres < 1e-8 AND converged), so the qualifying grid set can only shrink and this max can never INCREASE under the repair.
